donor.method: Curve25519 monotone precompute plus window DP transferred to P-256

bug.description: Original inner window-DP compares (total,S,M), preferring fewer S at an equal total, while frozen 0.8S+M requires fewer M (equivalently more S). The saved best candidate and score-guided beam already compare (total,M,...); they are not the bug.
bug.correction: Use rank (total,M,S) only for inner DP and first-window tie-break; retain score data tuple (total,S,M) and original beam ranking.
bug.scope: one bounded new-region run; prior plans, source, traces and claims unchanged

new_region.grammar: Unfixed whole exponent; monotone precompute exponents up to 127 from sums of existing values; exact leading/nonleading bit-window DP of width at most 8; compare corrected inner DP with original guided and hash beam policies at matched assessment cap

bounds.new_scope: new20261026 replication; old historical deadline not revived

claim_ceiling: A deterministic selection-package comparison on one historically exposed target at a tiny budget. Policy-specific hash tie salts differ too. Not an agent-skill, collaboration, autonomous-memory, serving-family, held-out-target or generalization test.
